notes.title: Released another game, aggressive and fast.
notes.content:
Released another game, aggressive and fast. In the spirit of the first Quake, however, with experimental gameplay.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1210660/Daemonic_Runner/

notes.title: Critical bug fixed!
notes.content:
Important.
08/01/2018 Fixed critical bug on the third map.

If your save already contains a bug, try selecting the 'restart chapter' option at the main computer.

[ version in the window title bar: RoSt corr4 ]

notes.title: Update from 08.20.2016
notes.content:
Update from 08.20.2016

- Disabled option that allowed for breaking game speed
- Added ability to restart the game from the last checkpoint

notes.title: Update of 22 April
notes.content:
Update 22.04.2016

1. It is now possible to restart the third chapter.
2. Better checkpoints: now your game will not be saved in an impossible situation.
3. Minor balance tweaks. A little more titanium shields, better enemy AI.
4. Improved final screen graphics.
